verdict.rationale: Microsoft's Transparency Note says Copilot centers its responses on high-ranking web content and provides hyperlinked citations after generated text, or in transcripts in voice mode. That directly covers web-grounded answers with source citations, and the Researcher feature adds synthesis of information. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that results are current or real-time, and independent or hands-on corroboration of citation quality, since all support comes from vendor docs and community items don't address this capability.
